newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips 1996 result ravaged by charges.
newsitem.headline: Philips 1996 result ravaged by charges.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV on Thursday reported a 1996 net loss of 590 million guilders after booking net extraordinary charges of over 1.3 billion guilders in the year.
The company reported a net profit from normal operations during the year of 723 million guilders and the dividend was held unchanged at 1.60 guilders per common share.
"The year 1996 was a severe disappointment, due to a much lower level of sales growth and costs which grew faster than sales," Philips said in a statement.
However, the company said it anticipated its current businesses would continue to grow in 1997.
"We had to take substantial restructuring charges, and we are committed to a return to profitability and to the achievement of a positive cash flow of over one billion guilders," it said.
